radar.title: Radar
radar.subtitle: Events from news, filings and speculation, ranked by opportunity score.

empty.discover: No new ideas above the threshold. Radar checks sources every 15 minutes.
empty.watchlist: No watchlist events in the last 7 days.
empty.portfolio: No portfolio events in the last 7 days.

hints.discover: Instruments you neither hold nor watch.

thesis.title: Theses
thesis.subtitle: Claims from analysis triggers. A draft becomes active only when you confirm it.
thesis.empty: No theses in this view. Open a finished analysis with triggers to create a draft.
thesis.noActiveHint: This thesis has no active version. Review the draft before confirming it.
thesis.createHint: Copy the triggers into a draft for your review. This does not place an order.
thesis.history: Event history, {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}
thesis.evidenceHint: A status other than open needs at least one evidence item. Each item needs a source, date and an HTTP(S) URL or reference. Mark rumours explicitly.
thesis.draftHint: Edit the claims and their invalidation conditions. Confirmation makes this revision active and replaces the previous active revision. It does not place an order.
thesis.saveBeforeConfirm: Save changes before confirming the revision.

errors.loadFailed: Theses could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.failed: The request failed. Your changes may not have been saved. Reload and check before trying again.
errors.notFound: The thesis, claim or source analysis was not found. Return to the list and check the link.
errors.invalid: Some fields are invalid. Check the text, evidence references and dates.
errors.conflict: The thesis changed. Reload and review its current state before trying again.
errors.analysis_not_finished_with_card: The analysis is not finished or has no decision card. Wait for it to finish.
errors.analysis_has_no_triggers: The analysis has no triggers to copy into a thesis.
errors.revision_not_draft: This revision is no longer a draft. Reload to review the active revision.
errors.revision_version_conflict: The revision version changed. Reload and review it before saving again.
errors.revision_edit_conflict: Someone saved this draft in the meantime. Reload it and check the changes before saving again.
errors.claim_revision_not_active: This claim is not in the active revision. Reload and use the active revision.
errors.claim_status_conflict: The claim status changed. Reload and review the evidence before saving again.
errors.evidenceRequired: Enter a rationale. For a non-open status, add evidence with source, date and URL or reference. Complete every evidence row.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.flexUnconfigured: IBKR Flex is not configured. Set IBKR_FLEX_TOKEN and IBKR_FLEX_QUERY_ID in .env.
portfolio.emptyBody: Once IBKR Flex is configured (token and a Flex Query with OpenPositions, Trades, CashReport), positions load every morning at 7:15. For development, demo data runs in a separate stack: infra/scripts/demo-stack.sh up.

disclaimer: Research aid, not investment advice. The decision is yours.

command.placeholder: Search a symbol, screen or action
command.shortcuts: Shortcuts: ⌘K search · g o/r/e/s/p go to · + new proposal

proposal.title: New proposal for analysis
proposal.intro: Propose an instrument or a hypothesis. Agents test your hypothesis against evidence instead of assuming it.
proposal.symbolsHint: e.g. MSFT, ASML. They can also be detected from pasted text.
proposal.hypothesisHint: Why are you interested? What do you expect?

depth.label: Analysis depth
depth.deepHint: all agents + MiniMax · uses daily budget

proposal.previewNote: The analysis runs in the background; the result arrives as a signal and on Telegram.
proposal.listEmpty: No proposals yet. The + Propose button is always in the header.

overview.title: Overview
overview.treemapHint: Area is weight, color is daily change. Click opens a preview.
overview.pulseHint: Each dot is an event: size is score, dashed is rumor.

inZone.title: In zone
inZone.empty: No position is in its entry zone right now. Prices are still above the zones.

ux.title: Design system
ux.intro: Live examples of tokens, motion (MO-xx) and linking (LX-xx) from DESIGN.md.
ux.reduced: Motion is reduced automatically when the device asks for less motion.

watchlist.duplicate: This instrument is already on the watchlist.
watchlist.empty: The watchlist is empty. Add a symbol above or from an instrument preview.

instrumentPage.notFound: Instrument {symbol} is not in the database.
instrumentPage.notFoundHint: Add it to the watchlist or propose it for analysis; its data then loads.
instrumentPage.noBars: No price data yet. The source is unreachable or the instrument is not supported.

signalsPage.title: Signals
signalsPage.subtitle: All signals in one place. The decision is yours.
signalsPage.rumorCannotAccept: A rumor cannot be accepted until an official source confirms it.

proposalsPage.submitError: The proposal could not be submitted.

entriesPage.title: Entries
entriesPage.subtitle: Quality positions at a good price, and why they fell. Code computes zones and the ladder; the model judges the cause.

empty.active: No rule produced a candidate. Rules run every weekday after the close.
empty.reach: No price is in its entry zone right now.
empty.near: No price is near its entry zone.
empty.all: No price data for the portfolio and watchlist.

entriesPage.analysisPending: The cause has not been assessed yet (local model unavailable or analysis queued).
entriesPage.noDip: No dip to explain. The zone shows the level being waited for (SMA200).

overreaction.name: Overreaction
overreaction.detail: {z} σ move on a minor news item

valuation.note: Grey band: 20th–80th percentile of the last 5 years.

ladder.note: Suggested limit orders in 1 ATR steps above the stop. You place orders yourself.

map.label: Entry map
map.caption: Left is closer to the zone, higher is cheaper. Size shows the number of rules, colour the cause. Dashed circle: no valuation data.

analysisPage.title: Analyses
analysisPage.subtitle: Deep agent analyses: what they saw, how they argued and what they propose. The decision stays yours.
analysisPage.notFound: This analysis does not exist. It may have been deleted or the link is wrong.
analysisPage.loadFailed: The analysis could not be loaded. The rest of the page works, try again in a moment.
analysisPage.empty: No deep analysis yet. Start one from an instrument page with the Deep analysis button.
analysisPage.opinion: This is the agents' opinion, not an instruction. The rating places no order and creates no signal. You decide.

decision.title: Final decision
decision.pending: The decision appears when the portfolio manager finishes. Follow the steps below meanwhile.
decision.queued: The analysis is waiting in the queue. It starts when the previous one is done.
decision.failedHint: Partial steps are below. Run the analysis again from the instrument page.

launch.notFound: This instrument cannot be analyzed because it is not in the database.
launch.failed: The analysis could not be started. Try again in a moment.
launch.limitReached: The daily limit is reached. New deep analyses can start tomorrow.

latest.title: Latest deep analyses
latest.empty: No deep analysis for this instrument yet.

hypothesis.title: Your hypothesis
hypothesis.note: The hypothesis check is the agents' opinion, not a fact.

card.title: Decision card
card.note: A guide for judgment, not an order. Size and rating are suggestions; you decide.
card.noScore: The check could not be computed.
card.lowConfidence: The deterministic check disagrees with the agents' rating. Judge with more care and read the reports.

actionHint.Buy: The agents suggest opening or adding to a position.
actionHint.Overweight: Raise an existing position above its usual weight; a new one makes sense.
actionHint.Hold: Keep an existing position, no need to buy more.
actionHint.Underweight: Trim an existing position below its usual weight; do not open a new one.
actionHint.Sell: The agents suggest closing the position.
actionHint.REVIEW: The agents reached no clear rating. Read the reasoning.

outlook.title: Outlook by horizon
outlook.note: Code computes the outlook from prices and fundamentals with fixed rules, not the agents. It is not a forecast.
outlook.none: No outlook for this analysis (no price snapshot).

rsi14.label: RSI (14 days)
rsi14.text: {value}: {stance, select, pro {oversold, often followed by a bounce} contra {overbought, often followed by a pause} other {within the usual 30–70 band}}

cross_50_200.label: 50- vs 200-day average
cross_50_200.text: {value}: {stance, select, pro {short trend above long} contra {short trend below long} other {trends are equal}}

valuation.label: Valuation vs own 5-year history
valuation.text: {stance, select, pro {cheaper than usual} contra {pricier than usual} other {close to usual}} (score {value})

review.title: Weekly reviews
review.insufficient: Insufficient evidence to suggest a status.
review.confirmHint: Change the claim status to {status}? The proposal and evidence will be recorded in its history.
review.stale: This review is outdated. Refresh to see the current claim and proposals.
review.unverified: Review details are unavailable. Acceptance is disabled until the review can be verified.
review.failed: The review failed. The claim status is unchanged.
review.noEvidence: No evidence was available for this review.
review.truncated: Coverage is partial. Some evidence was omitted.
review.done: Review complete. Proposals do not change claim statuses until accepted.
review.skipped_limits: Review skipped because the review limit was reached.
review.empty: No weekly reviews yet. Claim statuses remain as recorded.
review.loadError: Reviews could not be updated. Refresh to try again.
review.conflict: The claim or proposal changed. Refresh and review it again before deciding.

trackRecord.title: Track record
trackRecord.subtitle: How signals turned out at the chosen horizon. Your proposals are measured apart from system signals.
trackRecord.hitRateHint: Share of outcomes that moved in the signal's direction
trackRecord.avgReturnHint: In the signal's direction, from the signal price to the end of the horizon
trackRecord.lowSampleHint: Fewer than {min} outcomes, the number is not reliable yet.
trackRecord.lowSampleBanner: Fewer than {min} outcomes. These numbers are early and will still move.
trackRecord.calibrationHint: Do stronger signals hit more often? When well calibrated, the hit rate rises with strength.
trackRecord.empty: No measured outcomes for the {days} d horizon yet. An outcome is computed once the horizon has passed. Awaiting outcome: {pending}.
trackRecord.error: Could not load the track record.

weights.title: Weight proposal
weights.hint: From measured outcomes, the system proposes how much more or less to trust each signal source. A weight multiplies the strength of new signals. It only changes when the 95% interval clearly differs from the baseline, and only after you confirm.
weights.defaults: No weights confirmed yet: every source counts at 1.00.
weights.basis: Proposal from {date} · {days}-day horizon · baseline {rate} over {count} system signals

reason.not_significant: Not clearly different from the baseline
reason.better: Hits more often than the baseline
reason.worse: Hits less often than the baseline

weights.unchanged: No weight would change. You can dismiss this proposal.
weights.confirmText: New weights will scale the strength of new signals from these sources. Existing signals stay as they are. You can calculate a new proposal at any time.

error.stale_proposal: Weights changed after this proposal was made. Calculate a new one.
error.not_pending: This proposal is no longer open. Calculate a new one.
